# Rental contract

This contract is made between Anna Berg (the landlord) and Omid Rahimi and Lena Vogt (the tenants).

## 1 Parties

The landlord rents the flat on the second floor of Lindenweg 12, 10115 Berlin, to the tenants. Both tenants are jointly liable for every duty under this contract.

## 2 Rent

### 2.1 Amount

The monthly rent is 1,150 EUR without utilities. The advance payment for utilities is 210 EUR a month.[^1]

### 2.2 Payment

The rent is paid by the third working day of each month to the account the landlord names. A late payment costs 5 EUR for each reminder.

## 4 Termination

### 4.1 Notice

Either party may end this contract in writing. The notice period is three months, counted to the end of a calendar month. The letter must reach the other party by the third working day of the first month of the period.

A notice sent by e-mail alone is not valid. It must be signed by hand by every tenant named in section 1. If one tenant signs and the other does not, the notice has no effect for either of them.

The landlord may end the contract only for one of the reasons the law allows, such as own use or a serious breach of this contract. The reason must be stated in the letter, with the facts it rests on.

After a notice, the tenant lets the landlord show the flat to people who may rent it next, on weekdays between 10 and 18 o'clock, after asking at least two days before.

At the end of the contract, the tenant returns every key, including the keys the tenant had copied. The flat is handed over clean and empty, and the meters are read together on that day.

If the tenant stays in the flat after the contract has ended, the contract does not go on by itself. The landlord may ask for a fee for each day of use, equal to the last rent.

Repairs the tenant has to make before the end are done by a trade firm, unless the landlord agrees in writing that the tenant does them alone. Small marks from normal use are not damage.

Holes for pictures and shelves are filled and painted over in the colour of the wall. Wallpaper the tenant put up is taken off, unless the next tenant agrees to keep it and says so in writing.

The landlord writes down the state of each room at the handover, with photos. Both parties sign the record, and each keeps a copy. A defect that is not in the record can't be charged later.

Mail that still comes for the tenant after the end is sent on for three months to the new address the tenant gives. After that, it is returned to the sender.

### 4.2 Deposit

The deposit is three months' rent without utilities. It is paid back within six months after the flat is handed over, less any costs the tenant still owes.

[^1]: The advance payment is adjusted after each yearly settlement.
